title: Researching a Warehouse's Immediate Needs

children:
The immediate needs module links the receiving and outbound processes 
 to fulfill the immediate needs of your warehouse. There are two main components 
 of the immediate needs process: the logging of an immediate needs request, 
 and the fulfillment of that immediate need. Logging involves the system 
 generating an immediate needs request to indicate that an entity (shipment, 
 work order, replenishment, or short-picked shipment) cannot be completely 
 fulfilled. The fulfillment process involves the system taking newly-received 
 item quantity and automatically allocating this quantity to fulfill the 
 immediate need. Users can view a list of the current immediate needs requests 
 and their statuses on the Immediate Needs Insight Screen. These screens allow you to 
 search for immediate needs requests using several search criteria fields. 
 Once you fulfill an immediate need, the system will automatically close 
 and delete the immediate needs request from the records grid.
NOTE: If there is no inventory currently in the warehouse for an immediate needs-eligible item, the shipment with this item will remain on the completed wave, and

NOTE: If you are using the Immediate Needs Insight screen and want more details about insight-specific features, see the topic
The following is discussed in this topic:
Changing an Immediate Need Record's Priority

Open the Immediate 
 Needs Insight screen.

Enter values 
 in the criteria fields to define your immediate needs search (some 
 key field explanations are below).

- Request Key Field: This 
 field identifies the system process that triggered an immediate needs 
 request.

- Internal Request Num Field: 
 This field represents the system-assigned next number that is associated 
 with an immediate needs request.

- Display Requests Currently Being 
 Fulfilled Checkbox: You can use this checkbox to have the system 
 only display immediate needs requests that are currently being fulfilled, 
 but have not yet been completely fulfilled (for example, inventory that 
 has not reached the fulfill location).

- Internal Fulfillment Num Field: 
 This represents the internal number of the object fulfilling an 
 immediate needs request. This value is a unique key of the immediate needs 
 request.

- Logged Date / Time Range Field: 
 This field indicates the day or time that the system generated the immediate 
 needs request.
Press the Apply or Search button. The system will display the results of your search.

- Note that you can delete an immediate needs request. Keep in mind that deleting immediate needs tied to work order details is not allowed. When selecting multiple immediate needs for deletion, the system deletes them in order.  If it meets an immediate need it cannot delete, it stops processing and displays an error, and does not delete the remaining immediate needs.

Changing an Immediate 
 Need Record's Priority...

An immediate needs request's priority setting determines when the 
 system will attempt to fulfill it. The system assigns a default priority 
 setting to an immediate needs request, as defined in the Immediate Needs 
 Trigger. However, you can manually change a request's priority on the Immediate Needs Insight screen.

First, 
 perform a search for a particular  immediate need record on the Immediate Needs Insight Screen.

To change a record's 
 priority setting, do the following :
- Select a record or multiple records from the grid, and select the Change Priority option from the Actions Menu. The system will display a dialog where you can enter a new priority value.
- Click or tap on the desired Immediate Needs record and then under Actions, select Edit.
